stories.title: Jensen Huang Carried a Secret for More Than a Year. It Led to His Downfall.
stories.summary: Nvidia's leader, Jensen Huang, resigned from the company he founded due to a secret he kept for over a year. His relationship with a female customer, which he claimed was strictly business, ultimately led to his downfall.

stories.title: OpenAi shuts down robot unit second time in six years, but wants everyone to know that the company is com
stories.summary: OpenAI has closed its robot unit for the second time in six years.

stories.title: Meta fined $887 million for accessing Android users' photos; Italian regulator cites 'lack of co-operatio
stories.summary: Meta received an $887 million fine from an Italian regulator for accessing Android users' photos. The regulator cited a lack of cooperation from the company.

stories.title: SpaceX Starship historic landing
stories.summary: SpaceX's Starship achieved a historic landing.

stories.title: ‘Not going to enrich anybody's lives’: Thousands protest in Scotland against large-scale AI data centres
stories.summary: Thousands of people in Scotland are protesting against the construction of large-scale AI data centers, arguing that these centers will not improve anyone's lives.

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s Downfall Brings Disbelief in Taiwan
stories.summary: The resignation of Nvidia's chief executive, Jensen Huang, caused surprise in Taiwan, his birthplace, where he is a well-regarded figure.

stories.title: Sebi plans AI guardrails for capital markets, stresses human oversight in critical decisions
stories.summary: Sebi is developing guidelines for the responsible use of artificial intelligence in capital markets, prioritizing investor protection and human oversight in critical decisions. The regulator is also strengthening its cybersecurity and exploring ways to attract startups to its Innovators Growth Platform.

stories.title: US To Offer India Lower Tariffs Than Competing Nations: Piyush Goyal Makes It Official
stories.summary: The United States will offer India lower tariffs compared to other nations, as confirmed by Piyush Goyal. This development is part of ongoing discussions between New Delhi and Washington to finalize the initial phase of their proposed bilateral trade agreement.

stories.title: Ground Stop Highlights Chronic Vulnerabilities in Air Traffic System
stories.summary: Recent failures in the Federal Aviation Administration's air traffic control system have highlighted ongoing vulnerabilities. These disruptions have occurred as officials work to upgrade the aging infrastructure.

stories.title: A Human Reads the Anthropic I.P.O. Filing
stories.summary: An analysis of Anthropic's IPO filing notes its unusual openness about existential risks. The question remains whether this level of honesty provides reassurance.

stories.title: US floated idea of Ukraine swapping land for NATO membership, Zelensky says
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky stated that the United States suggested Ukraine could trade some of its territory for NATO membership. This proposal indicates a potential new approach to resolving the conflict and integrating Ukraine into Western alliances.

stories.title: Grounded: Unraveling the Nationwide Flight Chaos
stories.summary: A nationwide flight disruption occurred, causing widespread chaos for travelers. The situation highlights vulnerabilities in air travel systems and the significant impact such events have on public mobility.

stories.title: ‘India No Longer a Democracy’: Rahul Gandhi's All-Out Attack On Modi Govt At Bharat Summit
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi criticized the Modi government at the Bharat Summit, asserting that India is no longer a democracy. His remarks indicate a strong political opposition to the current administration's policies and governance.

stories.title: Judge halts Trump plan to redevelop Washington, DC, golf course
stories.summary: A judge has stopped former President Trump's plans to redevelop a golf course in Washington, D.C. This legal decision impacts the future of the property and its proposed changes.

stories.title: Parliament winter session likely in 1st week of December; delimitation bill to be in focus
stories.summary: The winter session of Parliament is expected to begin in the first week of December, with a focus on the delimitation bill. This upcoming session will address important legislative matters, including the redrawing of electoral boundaries.

stories.title: US Labor Department official warns H-1B visas cannot be used as business model, signals wider crackdown | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: A US Labor Department official has issued a warning that H-1B visas should not be used as a business model, indicating a potential increase in enforcement actions. This suggests a broader effort to address how these visas are utilized by companies.

stories.title: Canada freezes intake cap for international students till 2029 in new immigration plan
stories.summary: Canada has decided to maintain its current intake cap for international students until 2029 as part of its new immigration strategy. This measure aims to manage the number of international students entering the country over the next several years.

stories.title: International students turn to US again? Report says study interest jumps 40% after midterms
stories.summary: A recent report indicates a significant increase in international student interest in studying in the United States, with a 40% jump observed after the midterms. This suggests a renewed appeal of US educational institutions for students from other countries.

stories.title: UK Sees Dramatic 20% Drop in International Student Visa Applications as Migrants Face Growing Uncertainty
stories.summary: The United Kingdom has experienced a substantial 20% decrease in international student visa applications. This decline occurs as migrants face increasing uncertainty regarding their status and opportunities in the UK.

stories.title: As students rely on AI in college applications, admissions offices scramble to keep up
stories.summary: Admissions offices are struggling to adapt as students increasingly use artificial intelligence in their college applications. This trend presents new challenges for institutions trying to evaluate applicants fairly.
